name: Super Mario Bros.™
description:
For more than 25 years, the Super
Mario series has conquered the
charts, and won the hearts of fans the
world over.

Now you can discover - or
rediscover - the original game that
made Mario a household name.

Run and jump with Mario or Luigi
through caves and castles, down
pipes and across platforms, and face
off against Bowser to rescue your
beloved Princess Peach.

It may be more than a quarter of a
century old, but Super Mario Bros. is
still as enchanting as ever!

여기에는 고객님의 건강와 안전을 위한 중요한 내용이 기재되어 있습니다. 
또한 본체의 사용설명서도 함께 읽어 주십시오.
